papers.title_en: From Vision to Interaction: Evaluating Dynamic Social Intelligence of VLM Agents in ALIVE-World
papers.authors: Yue Xu, Xiaoyu Qin, Sihan Zhao, Ze-en Xiong, Jia Jia
papers.evidence: 构建具身仿真环境，评估智能体的多模态感知、行动与动态社交能力。
papers.tldr: 现有社交智能评估多依赖文本抽象、静态推理或缺少真实社交动态的具身模拟，难以覆盖持续互动过程。本文提出ALIVE-World具身仿真环境，支持多模态、连续的人际交互，要求智能体感知线索、推断潜在认知状态并采取行动以实现社交目标。该平台将感知、推理和行动纳入动态评测，有助于更全面地评估具身智能系统在复杂社会情境中的能力。
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications and take on social roles, dynamic social intelligence, the ability to continuously perceive multimodal cues, infer latent cognitive states, intervene through embodied actions, and ultimately achieve social goals, has become essential. However, existing evaluations largely fragment social intelligence into text-based abstractions, static reasoning tasks, or embodied simulators that lack social dynamics. These approaches fail to capture the multimodal, continuous, and interpersonal complexity of authentic human interactions. To bridge this gap, we introduce ALIVE-World, an embodied simulation environment supporting dynamic multimodal interactions encompassing egocentric vision, language, and non-verbal action. To provide socially grounded interactive feedback, we populate this environment with counterpart agents driven by a profile-conditioned, dual-system (intuitive-affective and logical-cognitive) architecture. Building upon this platform, we propose ALIVE-Bench to transform the assessment of social intelligence into a trackable quantitative framework. By deeply leveraging underlying environmental states and agents' internal variables, ALIVE-Bench systematically evaluates Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents across four critical dimensions: perception, understanding, influence, and outcome. Extensive evaluations reveal that dynamic social intelligence is fundamentally multi-dimensional and scenario-dependent. We identify a critical bottleneck between upstream perception and downstream social intervention, exposing VLM vulnerabilities in fine-grained proxemic awareness, adaptive intervention, and multi-party coordination. By uncovering these limitations and the diverse interaction strategies they produce, this benchmark provides actionable insights for the future behavioral alignment of multimodal agents.

papers.title_en: Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
papers.authors: Dong An, Tianyu Liu, Haoran Ding, Wen Yang, Anqing Duan, Zhengzhong Liu, Eric P. Xing, Guangyi Liu
papers.evidence: 通过学习三维点动力学预测机器人动作引发的场景变化。
papers.tldr: 机器人世界模型虽能依据动作生成未来视频，但被操作物体常出现塌陷或运动不一致，难以准确预测动作后果。本文将首帧提升为三维点，并用学习到的点动力学模型模拟其对机器人运动的响应，随后把模拟点渲染回视频。该方法把场景动力学与外观生成分开建模，有望让机器人获得更可靠的环境变化预测。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic world models predict future video frames from the current observation and a sequence of robot actions. While recent models follow the given actions closely, manipulated objects often collapse or move inconsistently with the action. We attribute this to the conditioning: an action, or a rendering of the robot, specifies where the robot goes but not how the scene responds, leaving a single video model to infer the interaction dynamics implicitly while also rendering appearance. We therefore separate dynamics prediction from visual rendering, with 3D point dynamics as the proxy between them. Specifically, we lift the first frame into 3D points, simulate how they respond to the robot's motion with a learned point dynamics model, and render the simulated points back into pixel-aligned videos that any video model can read. In controlled experiments on the DROID dataset with two video renderers of different architectures, this point dynamics proxy reduces object motion error by 8.6% and 6.2% without degrading image quality, and by 8.1% on a real bimanual robot. Moreover, the video follows the simulation: more accurate dynamics yield more accurate object motion, and editing the points steers the video. This suggests that advances in dynamics modeling can translate into more faithful robotic world models.

papers.title_en: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
papers.authors: John Won, Yonghoon Dong, Jinwoo Shin
papers.evidence: 训练世界模型预测动作变化对未来观测的影响，服务机器人策略评估与规划。
papers.tldr: 世界模型虽然能够生成逼真的未来视频，却可能无法捕捉细微动作变化对后续观测的影响，因而不利于机器人策略评估和规划。AFFECT提出动作效果匹配训练目标，通过对策略动作注入时间相关扰动，学习动作变化所引发的视觉变化分布。该设计使模型更关注动作与环境结果之间的因果联系，目标是提升对动态后果的预测忠实度，为基于模型的机器人决策提供更可靠的内部环境模型。
papers.abstract_en: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations. This limits their use in tasks such as robotic policy evaluation and model-based planning, where nearly identical actions can lead to qualitatively different outcomes. To address this, we propose AFFECT, an auxiliary training objective for learning the distribution of visual changes induced by action perturbations. Specifically, we inject temporally correlated noise into the actions of a policy trained on task-agnostic human teleoperation. We then train the world model so that its generated videos respond to this noise as the recorded videos do, without requiring repeated executions from the same initial state. Across OGBench simulation and real-world DROID and ALOHA-2 setups, AFFECT makes world-model rollouts more faithful to real outcomes. On DROID, the Pearson correlation between policy success rates in the world model and on the real robot rises from 0.47 to 0.79, alongside up to 23% lower FVD. These gains carry over to planning, where selecting actions with AFFECT-trained world models improves task success by up to 8.3%.

papers.title_en: Looking Right Is Not Being Right: Evaluating the Geometry of Agent-Built 3D Scenes
papers.authors: Ziyang Long, Yen-Liang Lin, Shifan Zhu, Allen Tu, Meher Gitika Karumuri, Chenqi Li, Srikumar Sastry, Sarosij Bose, Mellon M. Zhang, Hsin-Jung Yang
papers.evidence: 以扫描参考评估三维场景重建的表面、深度和家具位置
papers.tldr: 由智能体从视频构建的房间即使渲染逼真，也未必具有准确几何，因此需要可靠的重建评估方式。本文提出以真实房间激光扫描为参照，综合测量表面、深度和家具位置，并在三十个房间上比较不同输入条件。实验显示，直接由视频生成的智能体场景明显逊于稠密重建；提供点云后，编辑场景的得分接近输入几何。该评估揭示了视觉观感与几何精度的差异。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language agents can reconstruct rooms from video as editable 3D scenes, but convincing renders do not establish geometric accuracy. We introduce a scan-referenced evaluation and use controlled experiments to study reconstruction accuracy, the role of geometric inputs, and agents' ability to verify and correct their scenes. Our geometric score measures surface, depth, and furniture placement agreement with laser scans of 30 real rooms on a 0-100 scale. The strongest tested agent, GPT-6 Astra, scores 51.4 from video alone, while a dense reconstruction from the same video scores 75.9. Given the point cloud used for that reconstruction, Astra produces an editable scene that scores within three points of it. Agents also inherit input errors: rescaling the supplied geometry changes scene scale almost proportionally. During revision, viewing renders improves appearance more consistently than geometry. Logs of their tool calls show that agents repeatedly measure their inputs but rarely compare them with the scenes they build. To provide this missing check, we introduce a geometric error report that compares each saved scene with the agent's input points and lists the largest discrepancies. Without new geometric evidence, the report raises the revision gains of GPT-6.1 Terra and Sol by 3.9 and 5.5 points over concurrent controls.

papers.title_en: Real-time neuromorphic audio and vision perception for autonomous robotic applications: Integration and experimental evaluation on a rover platform
papers.authors: Guillem Fustier-Castillo, Ruben Ribes-Serrano, Javier Naranjo-Alcazar, Vicent Ortiz-Castello, Pedro Zuccarello
papers.evidence: 在移动自主 rover 平台集成实时音频与视觉感知流程。
papers.tldr: 移动机器人需要在严格的延迟和能耗限制下持续理解周围环境，而神经形态感知方案常停留在离线评测或独立模块验证。本文在四轮移动平台上集成多条实时音频与视觉感知流程，包括传统音频分类和脉冲神经网络音频处理，并报告其系统实现与实验评估。工作将感知方法置于真实机器人平台运行，展示了从单项算法走向自主机器人环境理解的集成路径。
papers.abstract_en: Neuromorphic sensing and computing offer a promising alternative to conventional deep learning pipelines for mobile robots, where perception must run continuously under tight latency and energy constraints. However, most neuromorphic solutions are still evaluated offline or on isolated benchmarks, and their integration into complete robotic systems remains largely unexplored. In this technical report, a four-wheel rover platform is presented that combines three real-time perception pipelines: a classical audio tagging pipeline based on Pretrained Audio Neural Networks (PANNs) running on an NVIDIA Jetson GPU, a neuromorphic audio pipeline in which a spiking neural network (SNN) is deployed on the SynSense Xylo Audio~2 chip, and a neuromorphic vision pipeline in which events from an event-based camera are processed by the SpikeYOLO spiking detector for traffic cone detection. On the Xylo chip, the whole processing chain---from the microphone signal to the classification of low- and high-pitched sounds---is performed on-chip, while the host only configures the device and reads the output neurons. All models are deployed as containerised services and integrated through ROS~2, and a configurable action dispatcher maps the detected classes to robot behaviours, closing the loop between perception and actuation. The platform is demonstrated in a proof-of-concept scenario in which the robot reacts to sound classes detected by both audio pipelines and detects traffic cones with the event camera, showing the feasibility of integrating neuromorphic hardware into a multimodal robotic platform operating in real time.

papers.title_en: ArgsWorld: Unifying 3DGS Scene Reconstruction, Generation and Extrapolation with Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer
papers.authors: Weiming Chen, Shuaiyan Liu, Xinyu Shao, Zhewen Chen, Tian Guan, Yonghong He, Xitong Ling
papers.evidence: 用自回归扩散变换器生成显式三维高斯场景表示
papers.tldr: 许多视频世界模型只生成二维图像，难以直接提供机器人、仿真和渲染可用的三维场景资产。ArgsWorld提出自回归扩散变换器，在生成新视角时联合处理历史图像潜变量与新视角噪声潜变量，并持续更新显式三维高斯表示。由此将场景重建、生成和外推纳入同一框架，为从视觉世界模型获得可用三维结构提供方法。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive diffusion world models deliver strong video generation performance, yet they typically output only RGB frames rather than explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene representations, creating a gap between learned visual world dynamics and usable 3D assets for downstream robotics, simulation and rendering. To bridge this gap, we introduce ArgsWorld, an autoregressive diffusion model that also produces an explicit 3DGS scene. For each generation chunk, the diffusion transformer jointly processes clean historical image latents and noisy latents for new views. It keeps the historical image latents fixed and refreshes the scene features so that the Gaussian representation can be revised as new regions come into view. Our 3D Self-Forcing Distillation trains the model on its own generated histories using a mixture of single-view and multi-view data. Distribution matching supervises direct image latents and latents of Gaussian renderings at both generation and additional cameras. ArgsWorld unifies 3D scene reconstruction from posed images, scene generation from image or text prompts, and scene extrapolation across camera segments with disconnected endpoints. Experimental results demonstrate that ArgsWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple 3D scene modeling tasks. Project page: https://m4a1tastegood.github.io/ArgsWorld/

papers.title_en: SuperNav-1.5: Structured Spatial Memory For Agentic Navigation Systems
papers.authors: Jiarui Guo, Jinkai Zhang, Yuanhong Yu, Yongchen Zai, Futang Zhu, Ruizhen Hu, Sida Peng, Xiaowei Zhou
papers.evidence: 构建空间地图与可执行路线，支持跨区域和目标导航
papers.tldr: 面向连续会话和多个物体目标的导航，场景记忆既要避免场景图过于稠密带来的推理开销，也要能转化为实际路线。SuperNav-1.5让智能体构建分区占据地图，并在地图上维护与位置对应的记忆节点，用以引导其前往未探索区域和目标位置。该结构将场景级记忆与可执行几何路径衔接，支持更高效的代理导航，是面向环境理解和行动规划的空间记忆方案。
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenge of scene-level memory design for efficient navigation across sessions and successive object goals. Recent methods commonly represent a scene using scene graphs or image--text records. However, dense scene-graph representations impose substantial reasoning and context overhead on multimodal large language models, while image--text records cannot be directly converted into executable geometric routes. To address these limitations, we propose SuperNav-1.5, an agentic navigation system equipped with a structured spatial memory constructed by the agent. The memory consists of an area-segmented occupancy map annotated with agent-maintained, map-grounded memory nodes. This map guides the agent toward unvisited areas and provides executable routes to known locations. For multi-session navigation, we introduce agent-guided relocalization, whereby the agent infers an area prior from current observations and stored memory records to constrain geometric matching and localize the robot within the stored map. Together, these designs enable efficient navigation across session and successive object goals. Experiments show that our method outperforms baselines on single-object, multi-object, and demand-driven navigation benchmarks, with particularly strong gains in path efficiency. Multi-session evaluation demonstrates that the constructed memory can be reused, while deployment on a real quadruped robot further shows the system's applicability.

papers.title_en: Spiking World-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Mingquan Liu, Peng Zhou, Shanming Yao, Shuai Wang, Simo Wu, Malu Zhang
papers.evidence: 机器人世界动作模型预测操作动作引发的环境变化
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型能够预测机器人动作带来的环境变化，但网络规模大且规划时需反复运行，难以部署在机器人上。SpikingWAM提出脉冲式世界动作模型，以任务骨架状态表示机械臂和物体的关键点，避免对视频背景进行密集计算，并用脉冲神经网络进行预测。该设计将计算集中于任务相关位置，目标是降低动作规划中的推理开销。它直接研究具身机器人如何建立动作与环境结果之间的内部模型。
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) predict how the world responds to actions and offer a promising path toward general embodied intelligence, but they are large and run the network many times per plan, so they are hard to deploy on robots. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) compute with sparse binary spikes and use additions instead of multiplications, which saves power. However, existing WAMs use dense videos as the world state, so a spiking version would spend most of its computation on the background. We therefore introduce SpikingWAM, the first spiking WAM, which uses a sparse task skeleton as the world state. Inspired by biological motor control, which attends only to the key positions of a task, the Task Skeleton State (TSS) keeps the keypoints of the arm and the task objects, and a small spiking front end estimates the object keypoints from images. Body Frame Spike Coding (BFSC) and Grid Coincidence Attention (GCA) keep millimetre precision, and the Persistent Single Step Readout (PSR) runs the network once per plan. On the simulated benchmarks LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0, SpikingWAM achieves competitive success rates with far less energy than ANN methods and surpasses all compared methods on LIBERO-Plus. Real robot experiments further confirm its effectiveness. These results show that a task skeleton lets spiking networks implement WAMs at very low energy, offering a new solution for low power embodied intelligence. Project page: https://wxqnl.github.io/spikingwam/

papers.title_en: Go Far, Look Less: Active Multi-Room Reconstruction with Persistent Goals and Selective Views
papers.authors: Jiawei Jiang, Haonan Zhou, Wendi Hu, Jiabei Hu, Yina Xiang, Kaiyue Zhou, Gaoang Wang
papers.evidence: 主动式多房间三维重建通过选择视角高效恢复完整场景几何。
papers.tldr: 多房间住宅的主动三维重建需要在有限视图预算下恢复完整几何，但贪心视角选择可能反复打磨近处误差，或忽略远处房间；密集采集又会带来大量数据。ROAM-GS采用无需训练的策略，联合维护持续目标并选择可变长度的移动路径，只在路径终点采集视图。其表面重建记忆依据更新后缺陷和观测方向评估候选位姿，旨在更有效地覆盖多房间场景并提升重建效率。
papers.abstract_en: Active 3D reconstruction aims to allocate a sparse view budget to recover complete geometry and high-fidelity renderings. However, existing methods degrade sharply in multi-room homes: myopic next-best-view scoring gives transit no credit for distant rooms and over-polishes irreducible nearby residuals, whereas dense mappers reach far rooms only by streaming thousands of frames. We propose ROAM-GS, a training-free active multi-room reconstruction framework that couples persistent goals with selective views: each decision selects a goal and a variable-horizon prefix toward it, capturing only at its endpoint. A Surface Reconstruction Memory scores poses by projecting post-update defects and viewing directions. Persistent goals credit transit with their remaining value and are released once arrivals stop measurably improving them. Without per-scene tuning, ROAM-GS achieves state-of-the-art multi-room reconstruction while preserving single-room Replica fidelity, raising mean coverage from 74% to 93% on HSSD and from 47% to 96% (+11.7 dB PSNR) on HM3D, and matching 90-minute dense mapping using $173\times$ fewer views.

papers.title_en: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Vinay Udit Mohan, Xuchuan Huang, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias
papers.evidence: 跨具身三维潜在动作世界模型支持动作后果预测与零样本操作。
papers.tldr: 机器人操作世界模型通常依赖昂贵的带动作标注数据，并且难以迁移到不同形态的机器人。DexLatentWorld从重定向的人类操作示范点云中学习连续三维潜在动作，再通过对比目标使不同具身形态下的运动表示保持一致。统一的潜在动作空间用于支持跨机器人操作迁移与零样本泛化，降低了对特定机器人动作数据的依赖，并为具身智能中的规划和动作预测提供新的表示方式。
papers.abstract_en: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.

papers.title_en: WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
papers.authors: Richard Shaw, Arthur Moreau, Athanasios Papaioannou, Thomas Tanay, Zhensong Zhang, Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero
papers.evidence: 提出适应野外多视图图像不一致性的前馈式三维高斯重建框架。
papers.tldr: 真实环境的多视图图像常含有瞬时遮挡、光照变化和相机处理差异，导致前馈式三维重建质量下降。WildAnySplat提出学生—教师框架，由教师处理干净图像，再指导学生从野外输入中学习稳定且外观一致的规范表示。该框架面向前馈式三维高斯泼溅与新视角合成，旨在减少真实拍摄不一致因素的干扰，推动重建方法从受控采集走向自然场景。
papers.abstract_en: We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods.   To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data.   We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation.   Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.

papers.title_en: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
papers.authors: Yanzhe Chen, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Xiaokang Liu, Ke Sun, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.evidence: 通过多类操作任务评测具身智能体及其行动接口
papers.tldr: 基础模型能够推理复杂物理任务，但将意图转化为可靠机器人动作仍是具身智能落地的难点。论文提出RUIBench，覆盖五类任务套件中的30项操作任务，并以RUIKit组合多种动作抽象和交互形式，形成13种机器人使用接口。在共享感知与控制条件下，模拟实验显示仅改变接口就能使前沿智能体成功率从45%升至81%。研究凸显行动接口对具身系统能力的影响，并提供了系统化评测工具。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.

papers.title_en: EmboEagle: An Efficient Agentic Embodied Framework for Long-horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Fan Xu, Zhongtao Wang, Hao Wu, Yitong Zhu, Wenzhuo Ma, Long Li, Zhuohao Li, Zhisheng Chen, Rui Su, Kun Wang, Xian Wu, Wanli Ouyang
papers.evidence: 提出支持可靠长时程机器人操作的闭环具身智能体框架
papers.tldr: 长时程机器人操作包含多个相互依赖阶段，单独的世界动作模型容易累积物理误差，逐步调用视觉语言模型监督又延迟高且缺少空间记忆。EmboEagle构建闭环智能体框架，结合子任务条件化控制、潜空间自适应监督和记忆引导的几何恢复，并通过分阶段流匹配调整动作监督。该设计旨在提升跨阶段空间连续性和复杂操作执行可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robotic manipulation demands reliable execution across interdependent stages, yet standalone World-Action Models (WAMs) suffer from compounding physical errors, while stateless Vision-Language Model (VLM) supervision incurs prohibitive chunkwise latency and lacks 3D spatial persistence. We present EmboEagle, a closed-loop agentic framework that unifies subtask-conditioned WAM control, latent-space adaptive supervision, and memory-guided geometric recovery. First, we adapt sequential WAMs via decoupled two-stage flow matching that preserves cross-stage visual history while calibrating truncated action supervision at subtask boundaries. Second, without an auxiliary vision encoder, we distill teacher intervention decisions into a lightweight routing gate driven solely by the WAM Action Expert's pre- and post-chunk latent transitions and subtask embeddings. Third, upon invocation, the VLM decouples diagnostic status from discrete routing actions and executes parameterized recovery primitives grounded in structured memory (initial references, active grasp bindings, and tool traces), followed by mandatory post-repair verification. Across RMBench and LIBERO-Mem, EmboEagle achieves 91.3\% and 90.6\% average success, surpassing the strongest baselines by 8.0 and 9.8 percentage points, while boosting real-world success over VoLoAgent under identical executor weights. Moreover, adaptive gating cuts VLM calls by 74.2\% versus chunkwise monitoring (91.3\% vs. 93.7\% success).

papers.title_en: CarlHOI: Counterfactual Predictive Imagination for Generalizable Multi-Humanoid Object Interaction under Constrained Environments
papers.authors: Wenjie Lin, Jin Wei-Kocsis
papers.evidence: 使多个人形机器人团队能适应未见环境约束并协作搬运物体。
papers.tldr: 多个人形机器人协同搬运物体时，遇到未见障碍或环境布局变化，往往难以沿用既有协作策略并调整队形。CarlHOI提出反事实预测想象框架，以关系潜在世界模型表示人、物体和环境约束，并在内部评估可能的行动后果。系统据此使团队在不重新训练底层控制策略的情况下，适应绕行和队形变化等挑战。该工作推动具身智能从固定场景协作走向受约束环境中的泛化物体交互。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in physics-based humanoid control enable teams of varying sizes to coordinate their movements and cooperatively transport shared objects. However, adapting learned cooperative behaviors to unseen environmental constraints remains challenging, particularly when obstacles require coordinated detours and changes in team configuration. We propose CarlHOI, a counterfactual predictive imagination framework built upon a counterfactual-anchored relational latent world model (CarlWM) for human-object interaction (HOI), enabling multi-humanoid teams to adapt to unseen environmental constraints without retraining their underlying cooperative control policies. CarlHOI explicitly represents the shared object, individual humanoids, and environmental obstacles as interacting entities. Trained offline using counterfactual simulator rollouts, the model imagines alternative collective futures under different shared waypoint commands, predicting how the coupled humanoid team and object would respond. By evaluating these imagined outcomes through predicted progress, failure, and contact risks, and long-horizon value estimates, CarlHOI selects adaptive guidance commands while preserving the pretrained cooperative controller. We introduce a benchmark comprising three challenging obstacle-constrained transport tasks to evaluate adaptation and generalization. Despite being trained exclusively with four humanoids, our model generalizes without retraining to teams of two to ten humanoids, unseen obstacle geometries and placements, unseen objects, and novel combinations of environmental constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved cooperative transport success over evaluated baselines across diverse configurations. Results highlight the potential of counterfactual predictive imagination to extend pretrained multi-humanoid cooperative skills beyond their original training conditions.

papers.title_en: Beyond Episodic Recall: Experience-to-Knowledge Evolution for Lifelong Embodied Navigation
papers.authors: Weitao An, Chenghao Xu, Xu Yang, Cheng Deng
papers.evidence: 通过交互积累经验并支持后续具身导航
papers.tldr: 终身具身导航要求智能体在持续环境交互中积累经验，并将其用于后续目标搜索。现有方法保存历史观察或高维语义嵌入会带来不断增长的存储开销，而结构化场景表示又难以把经验转化为环境专属知识。本文提出双时间尺度的经验演化记忆框架EvoNav，将语义观察、空间关系和任务反馈线索组织为稀疏记忆。该设计旨在兼顾可扩展存储、检索与语义推理，为长期导航中的经验复用提供途径。
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong embodied navigation requires agents to accumulate experience through continuous interaction and reuse it for subsequent goal searches. Existing memory-enhanced methods typically retain historical observations or construct structured scene representations. However, storing observations or high-dimensional semantic embeddings incurs growing storage costs. Meanwhile, structured representations support retrieval and semantic reasoning but do not explicitly evolve accumulated experience into environment-specific knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose Experience-Evolving Memory (EvoNav), a novel two-timescale memory framework. It organizes semantic observations, spatial relations, and task-feedback cues into sparse experience atoms. During online operation, experience atoms continually consolidate repeated observations and form dynamic links based on transitions. At the slower timescale, EvoNav distills accumulated category co-occurrences and feedback signals into environment-specific structural knowledge without relying on predefined object--room relations. For each new goal, EvoNav combines direct goal evidence from experience atoms with learned structural knowledge to guide goal-directed search on the current traversability map. Experiments on single-goal, sequential multi-floor, and multimodal navigation demonstrate effective experience reuse and improved path efficiency with compact persistent memory, together with successful transfer to a real robot.

papers.title_en: SpatialMind: Adaptive Multi-Level Geometric Fusion for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Shibin Zhao, Hao Tan, Fan Yang, Haixin Wang, Feilong Chen, Yidong Ma, Chaoyang Zhao, Ming Tang, Jinqiao Wang
papers.evidence: 按任务选择多层级几何表示进行空间推理，契合多层级三维场景理解与几何融合。
papers.tldr: 多模态大语言模型在三维空间推理上仍受限，已有方法通常为所有任务使用单一几何粒度，或采用固定的多层级融合。SpatialMind针对任务需求自适应融合不同粒度的三维几何表示。系统实验显示，距离估计与路线规划等不同认知层级的任务需要不同几何粒度，说明固定融合难以通用。该研究为多层级三维场景理解和空间推理提供了任务适配思路。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in 2D visual understanding, yet remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Recent studies explore integrating 3D reconstruction models into MLLMs. However, these approaches either use a single geometric granularity across all tasks or adopt a fixed multi-level fusion scheme, regardless of task-specific reasoning requirements. Through systematic experiments on multi-level geometric fusion, we find that spatial tasks at different cognitive levels (e.g., distance estimation vs. route planning) require geometric representations of different granularities, revealing that fixed fusion cannot accommodate diverse spatial reasoning requirements. To bridge this gap, we propose SpatialMind, a task-adaptive framework for dynamically integrating multi-level geometric representations. SpatialMind employs GeoFus, a multi-layer geometric fusion module built around a gating network jointly conditioned on textual instructions, visual semantics, and geometric representations. This network adaptively modulates the contributions of shallow, intermediate, and deep geometric features across the layers of the LLM decoder. Furthermore, we introduce a negative-entropy regularization loss to mitigate gate collapse. Gate visualizations indicate that GeoFus adapts geometric granularity to task requirements. Experiments demonstrate that SpatialMind achieves competitive performance across spatial benchmarks, attaining a state-of-the-art score of 72.3 on VSI-Bench. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind.

papers.title_en: Where Demand Meets Supply: Spatial Elastic Consensus for Low-Bandwidth Collaborative Perception
papers.authors: Linshan Yan
papers.evidence: 面向联网车辆的三维协同感知与环境理解
papers.tldr: 单车传感器容易受遮挡和探测范围限制，车辆间共享观测虽能补足信息，却面临紧张的通信带宽。论文提出空间弹性共识框架，让通信双方协商哪些空间区域更值得传输，并根据带宽弹性选择信息。该设计针对发送端单方面筛选和冗余传输问题，也避免掩码后卷积造成隐性扩散。工作为低带宽条件下的车载三维协同感知提供了新的机制。
papers.abstract_en: Occlusions and limited sensor range make ego-only 3D perception insufficient for safe driving. Collaborative perception addresses this by enabling connected vehicles to share complementary observations, yet it remains constrained by tight vehicular communication budgets. While spatial selection is more flexible than fixed-rate feature compression, existing selectors remain largely sender-driven and waste scarce bandwidth on ego-visible targets. Furthermore, applying convolutions after masking spreads isolated tokens into their neighborhoods, silently violating low-bandwidth constraints. To address this, we propose Spatial Elastic Consensus (SEC), a bandwidth-adaptive framework centered on bilateral demand-supply consensus. Instead of unilateral token selection, the ego vehicle formulates a content-aware demand prior while each collaborator evaluates its local supply. This single-round consensus allocates the token budget to critical ego-missed evidence rather than ego-visible redundancy, without transmitting dense maps. To guarantee exact budget compliance, an anti-dilation refine-before-mask pipeline refines features prior to discrete token selection, preventing receptive-field leakage. A lightweight deformable sampler then aggregates these sparse messages with learned local offsets, compensating for the spatial context lost to token selection and mitigating inter-agent pose drift. Evaluated at a stringent 64KiB budget, SEC consistently achieves the best AP@0.7 on the simulated OPV2V and V2XSet datasets and the real-world DAIR-V2X dataset. These results demonstrate that combining bilateral consensus with budget-exact transmission is key to efficient low-bandwidth collaborative perception.

papers.title_en: Autonomous Track Racing with a Commercially Available Humanoid: System Design and Real-World Deployment
papers.authors: Koki Inami, Takashi Sato, Hiroyuki Oka, Shota Takizawa, Yuya Takahashi, Amon Suzuki, Hayato Ono, Kohtaro Ihara, Yuki Noka, Shohei Matsugu
papers.evidence: 实体人形机器人结合视觉感知、路径跟踪与学习策略导航运动
papers.tldr: 人形机器人虽已能通过学习实现稳定奔跑，但在真实赛事中自主适应陌生场地、跟踪赛道并控制配速仍具挑战。本文报告一套部署于商用Unitree G1的人形机器人竞速系统，整合视觉车道感知、路径跟踪，以及结合人类运动先验训练的强化学习策略。系统参加多个距离项目的真实比赛，展示了无需人工干预完成竞速的能力，为具身智能从实验室走向真实环境提供了系统级案例。
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based methods now let humanoids run robustly, and they have begun to compete in athletic events. Yet few reports describe a complete autonomous humanoid running system in an actual race, where the robot must follow a lane at a new venue, pace itself within hardware limits, and finish without intervention. We report such a system deployed on the Unitree G1, a commercially available general-purpose humanoid, in the 100 m, 400 m, and 1500 m events of the World Humanoid Robot Games 2026. The system integrates vision-based lane perception, path tracking, and a running policy trained by reinforcement learning with a human motion prior. To address the challenges of humanoid running, we stabilize head-camera images against body motion and use IMU-assisted leg odometry to bridge flight phases. To manage motor heating, we penalize hip-pitch torque during training, add heat-dissipation plates, and apply temperature-based speed limiting with event-specific pacing. The robot placed 13th of 74 in the 100 m, 10th of 44 in the 400 m first round before falling in the semifinal, and seventh of 35 in the 1500 m. In this deployment, thermal margin set the pace in every event, and the semifinal fall followed a lane-detection error.

papers.title_en: Multi-Rate Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling
papers.authors: Jingkai Shang, Edgar Torres, Duy Nguyen
papers.evidence: 以学习流场和几何保真目标细化稀疏点云
papers.tldr: 点云上采样需要从稀疏输入恢复更密集的形状，但不同局部区域的重建难度差异较大，固定积分步数会造成计算分配不均。MRFM为每个局部块自适应选择推理时的积分预算，并通过可微软展开和输入几何保真目标进行优化，再映射为离散步数完成生成。该方法在保持已学习速度场不变的情况下调整求解过程，为稀疏几何的高效细化提供了适应性方案。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching point-cloud upsamplers refine sparse inputs into dense point clouds by integrating a learned velocity field with a fixed temporal discretization. However, local reconstruction requirements vary substantially across a shape, while a shared solver budget applies the same temporal resolution everywhere. We propose Multi-Rate Flow Matching (MRFM), a patch-adaptive framework that selects an integration budget for each local patch at inference time while keeping the learned velocity field frozen. MRFM relaxes the discrete budget into a continuous variable, optimizes it online through differentiable soft rollouts using an input-derived geometric fidelity objective, and projects the result back to a discrete budget for the final solver rollout. Experiments on PU1K and PUGAN show strong reconstruction quality, while matched-budget permutation and multi-factor analyses demonstrate that the benefit depends on patch-specific allocation rather than on the step distribution alone. MRFM is accuracy-oriented and intentionally uses additional test-time optimization to obtain more suitable local temporal resolutions.

papers.title_en: MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space
papers.authors: Yibo Bai, Likui Zhang, Jinglei Zhang, Zhengbin Pang, Xingshen Song, Xiaoqing Yin, Jinsheng Deng
papers.evidence: 几何感知的四维手部重建利用深度先验支持真实交互与操作。
papers.tldr: 第一人称手部视频可为灵巧操作学习提供物理运动监督，但逐帧估计再提升到世界坐标，容易因近距离深度变化而耦合平移、朝向与关节误差，遮挡时问题更明显。MetricHand提出几何感知的流匹配框架，并从手物交互区域编码深度先验，以在度量世界坐标中重建连贯的四维手部运动。该方向旨在提升交互动作重建质量，并为操作学习和视觉语言动作预训练提供可靠监督。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.

papers.title_en: Physics-Informed Tactile-based Shape Estimation of Deformable Linear Objects
papers.authors: Rotem Atari, Stav Ashur, Avishai Sintov
papers.evidence: 利用触觉与本体感知在视觉受阻时估计柔性物体形状
papers.tldr: 柔性线状物体在操作中容易被遮挡，视觉和力觉方法也可能受到抓取位置歧义及环境干扰影响。本文研究仅凭触觉印迹与本体感知估计整体形状，并利用接触梯度、边界条件和物理信息约束恢复物体构型。该方向说明机器人可通过身体接触获得形状线索，为遮挡环境中的具身感知与柔性物体操作提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate shape estimation of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation, often hindered by visual occlusions and the high-dimensional configuration space of flexible materials. While Force/Torque (F/T) and vision-centric methods have been proposed, they frequently struggle with grasp-site ambiguities and environmental interference. In this letter, we investigate the hypothesis that global shape estimation can be achieved through tactile sensing and proprioception, without any visual perception. We contend that dense, high-resolution tactile imprints capture critical boundary conditions and contact gradients that are sufficient to resolve the high-dimensional configuration of the DLO. To prove this, we introduce a Physics-Informed Vision Transformer (ViT) framework that maps tactile images to a 3D vertex chain. By leveraging self-attention mechanisms and a physics-weighted loss function, our model enforces structural priors to ensure that the predicted geometry adheres to the object's physical manifold. Experimental results demonstrate that our tactile-based approach achieves superior reconstruction accuracy across Euclidean and Chamfer metrics. Furthermore, we demonstrate the efficiency of this modality, achieving model transfer to novel DLO materials and geometries. Our findings suggest that tactile feedback provides a robust and computationally efficient alternative for DLO state estimation in visually degraded or occluded environments.

papers.title_en: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
papers.authors: Jiawei Shen, Jie Feng, Junpeng Zhang, Guanbin Li, Wanyi Chen, Weisheng Dong, Guangming Shi
papers.evidence: 以层级场景理解引导连贯的三维室内场景生成
papers.tldr: 文本条件下的室内场景生成需要同时满足几何、功能与语义约束，但静态文本难以判断生成过程中的偏差，事后修补也可能破坏整体连贯性。本文提出由多模态大模型引导的闭环扩散框架，并通过层级先验场景理解将结构化布局与多视角视觉证据对齐，解析物体局部语境和场景全局语义。该设计将场景理解用于生成过程中的反馈校正，有助于构造更连贯、符合约束的室内布局。
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene coherence. We propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward Predictor, enabling correction decision making with reduced computation burden. Finally, Decision-Conditioned Trajectory-Consistent Diffusion is proposed to integrate selected corrections through transient conditioning and persistent clean-estimate projection, correcting object layout in the generated scene while preserving non-target arrangements throughout denoising. Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate improved functional consistency and semantic alignment while maintaining competitive generation quality and diversity.

papers.title_en: Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
papers.authors: Zeting Luo, Yifan Li, Shuai Yang
papers.evidence: 通过几何等证据迭代优化三维场景结构与外观。
papers.tldr: 图像转代码的三维场景重建通常只依据外观相似度，因而难以判断误差究竟来自几何、材质还是照明。LightHarness引入视觉语言模型驱动的智能体照明推理，并结合几何、内在属性及光照线索，在迭代过程中共同修正场景结构与外观。该框架将光照造成的阴影、反射等证据纳入重建过程，为可编辑场景提供更有依据的几何视觉优化方式。
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.

papers.title_en: MVSTF: Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion for LiDAR-Based Moving Object Segmentation
papers.authors: Jiaoju Zhou, Chao Ye, Xuebo Yang, Weiyang Lin
papers.evidence: 利用多视角时序点云分割动态物体，服务于移动机器人环境感知。
papers.tldr: 自主移动机器人在动态环境中会遇到遮挡、视角受限及物体边界模糊等问题，影响对运动目标的识别。MVSTF将连续激光雷达点云转换为多视角图像和特征差异，再通过多分支网络并行提取时空与维度特征，实现移动物体分割。该方法强调多视角时序信息融合，可为机器人理解周围动态场景提供感知支持，但不涉及层级语义分解或机器人导航动作。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots confront significant chal lenges in recognizing the motion properties of objects in dy namic environments. However, existing methods are hindered by limitations such as boundary ambiguity, occlusion, viewpoint constraints, and training complexity. In this paper, we propose an innovative end-to-end Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion network, named MVSTF, which utilizes sequential point clouds to generate multi-view images and feature differences, and designs a multi-branch network to extract spatio-temporal and dimen sional features in parallel, and realizes high-precision moving object segmentation. First, sequential point clouds are utilized to generate multi-view images and feature differences. Then, an end-to-end multi-branch network including Dual Down-sampling Blocks (DDB), Spatial Attention Blocks (SAB), Multi-Kernel Convolutional Neural Network blocks (MKCNN), Dual Feature Fusion Blocks (DFFB), and the Point Fusion (PF) module, is designed to extract motion features from feature differences and geometric and semantic features from multi-view images. Finally, an auxiliary semantic head is introduced to further improve the algorithm's robustness and the model's interpretability. This work is validated on the SemanticKITTI and KITTI-Road bench marks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SemanticKITTI MOS validation set and the KITTI-Road validation set, and competitive results on the hidden SemanticKITTI-MOS test set. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhouJJ111/MVSTF.

papers.title_en: Body of Evidence: Triangulating 3D Human Pose with Geometry-Conditioned Depth
papers.authors: Erik Brorsson, Kilian Freitag, Josef Bengtson, Kristofer Bengtsson, Lars Hammarstrand, Knut Åkesson, Fredrik Kahl
papers.evidence: 从图像预测关节深度并用于增强多视角三角化
papers.tldr: 多相机人体姿态估计中，遮挡可能使关节只在单个相机中可见，单独的二维观测无法确定其深度。BoE联合预测各相机中的关节位置与深度，并利用先前重建的人体三维几何作为深度上下文；随后通过可学习的深度感知三角化，将预测深度约束融入可微代数三角化。该设计旨在稀疏观测甚至单相机有效观测下恢复姿态，为几何约束的人体深度估计提供方法。
papers.abstract_en: Even in multi-camera setups, occlusions can leave individual body joints with only a single usable 2D observation. Such an observation defines a viewing ray but leaves the joint's depth undetermined. We introduce Body of Evidence (BoE), a multi-view 3D human pose estimator that predicts per-camera joint depths alongside 2D joint locations. To reduce monocular depth ambiguity, we propose geometry-conditioned depth prediction, which combines image features with previously reconstructed 3D body geometry as contextual depth cues. We further introduce learnable depth-aware triangulation (LDAT), which augments differentiable algebraic triangulation with predicted depth constraints, enabling reconstruction even from a single contributing camera while preserving the benefits of geometric triangulation when multiple views are available. The reconstructed 3D poses subsequently guide depth prediction in the next iteration, allowing depth estimates and 3D geometry to progressively refine each other. Experiments on CMU Panoptic demonstrate state-of-the-art in-domain performance and superior average performance across evaluated camera subsets and unseen camera arrangements. BoE is particularly effective under sparse camera coverage, outperforming the previous state of the art by 10.6 AP25 points in the challenging three-camera setting.

papers.title_en: Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
papers.authors: Shuang Wu, Jiachen Qian, Youtian Lin, Feihu Zhang, Philip Torr, Yao Yao, Xun Cao
papers.evidence: 扩散变换器直接建模体素符号距离场，属于相关的三维几何生成方法
papers.tldr: 现有三维生成方法通常先将几何压缩到潜变量，再由生成模型恢复形状，这会增加表示设计依赖。本文提出Direct3D-V3，舍弃变分自编码器，以扩散变换器直接建模原始体素符号距离场。该方法在训练和采样阶段均操作于原生体素域，并着重提升几何可靠性。它为三维几何生成提供了不同于潜空间建模的路线，与变换器三维重建在几何表示和建模方面相关，但任务并非从观测中重建场景。
papers.abstract_en: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a latent space and only then modeled by the generator. We take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that discards the VAE altogether and operates in the native voxel domain, directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling. To make this direct voxel formulation geometrically reliable, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization over neighboring voxels to suppress non-watertight surfaces, and convert predicted SDF grids into meshes via Marching Cubes so that rendered normal losses can supervise the model directly from its predicted SDF. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape. This latent-free design removes the reconstruction bottleneck, brings training under an objective in the native voxel domain, and yields meshes with substantially richer local detail. The predicted camera and native SDF voxel output further make Direct3D-V3 extensible to generative reconstruction, where diffusion is interleaved with normal-guided refinement to improve alignment with the observed view while the generative prior completes unseen regions. Project page: https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3.

papers.title_en: SparseHPS: A Unified Model for Human Pose and Shape across Depth Cameras and LiDARs
papers.authors: Ilya Zaychuk
papers.evidence: 从深度相机或激光雷达点云恢复人体度量姿态与形状，属于三维感知能力。
papers.tldr: 从点云恢复人体姿态与形状有助于机器人理解周围的人体，但既有方法往往针对单一传感器设计，且稀疏激光雷达输入需要较长序列。SparseHPS提出统一的传感器无关模型，使用共享网络从深度相机或激光雷达点云估计SMPL-X姿态、形状和全局位移，并支持单帧及连续流输入。该工作推动人体三维感知跨设备应用，可作为机器人环境理解中的人体感知模块。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering 3D human pose and shape from point clouds is central to motion capture, robotics and self-driving vehicles, because depth cameras and LiDARs sense a person directly in metric 3D and work under any lighting. However, current approaches are each tailored to one sensor type: point density differs by more than ten times between devices, public datasets are labeled with incompatible body models, and LiDAR approaches need long input sequences to offset sparse scans. In this work, we present SparseHPS, a novel sensor-agnostic network that recovers SMPL-X pose, shape and global translation from a human point cloud with one set of weights, for single frames and streams alike. Specifically, SparseHPS encodes the cloud with a LitePT backbone over sparse voxels, represents every joint by a learnable query decoded with one common head, localizes the body by voting over voxels, and draws temporal context from a causal memory of tokens from the seven preceding frames. A single model is trained on ten datasets that mix rendered clouds with real depth-camera and LiDAR captures, all converted to one body model. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results on the SLOPER4D and FreeMotion LiDAR benchmarks, where SparseHPS lowers the root-relative joint error by 22% and 11%, respectively, compared with the strongest prior method, which needs 32 frames. On real Azure Kinect captures of held-out HuMMan subjects, SparseHPS attains a joint error of 34.7 mm. Moreover, the current frame alone already yields the bulk of this accuracy.

papers.title_en: 3D Open-Vocabulary Detection via Visual Alignment and Generative Captions
papers.authors: Thomas E. Huang, Alex Zihao Zhu, Hao Xiang, Tianyi Cai, Jingwei Ji, Yuliang Zou, Jiafan Yu, Xin Huang, Mingxing Tan
papers.evidence: 将语义信息迁移到三维场景候选区域以支持开放词汇场景感知
papers.tldr: 户外三维开放词汇检测难以将二维视觉语言模型的语义知识有效迁移到三维实例，限制了对未知类别的识别。本文先生成无类别标注的三维候选区域，再依据候选框投影到图像后的区域提取视觉语言语义嵌入，并训练三维模型逐实例预测这些表示。框架还利用生成式描述补充领域信息与零样本能力。该方法增强三维场景中的语义感知，与机器人理解周围环境的需求相关。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection remains a significant challenge for outdoor scenes, with existing methods often struggling to effectively transfer the rich semantic knowledge from powerful 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into a 3D context. We propose a novel, two-part framework for this task. First, we introduce a direct, object-level distillation method. We generate class-agnostic 3D proposals to source regions from the entire scene, without relying on any manual labels. We leverage a spatially-aware VLM to extract a semantic embedding from each proposal's projected 2D bounding box and supervise our 3D model to predict this embedding on a per-instance basis. Second, to enhance zero-shot capability and inject domain-specific information, we employ a powerful Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as an image captioner to generate rich textual captions for each of these proposals. These captions are integrated into the training objective to directly align the 3D features with these rich semantics, creating a composite loss that combines direct feature distillation with caption-based semantic enrichment. Our experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, establishing a new state of the art in 3D open-vocabulary detection on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
